correctness.rationale: For p|2m the hypersurface Jacobian ideal is (x,y). The two blowup charts are the domains x^2 t=z^(2m) and y^2 s=z^(2m). Adjoining z^m/x (respectively z^m/y) yields finite birational normal A_(m-1) rings. Since xS= (x,z^m)R and modulo xS the even-polynomial subring has zero conductor in its rank-two extension by w, this is the entire conductor. Exceptional t=w^2 implies separable quadratic except for p=2, when purely inseparable. Proof applies for all m>=1. Standard-library semigroup checker passes m=1..16; finite checks are not proof for all m.

value.rationale: The normalizing map of the ordinary Nash blowup has nonnormal locus equal to its *entire* exceptional curve, with exact m-th order conductor scheme and a quadratic exceptional covering. In characteristic two, that cover is purely inseparable even though the normalized toric fan is characteristic-independent. This describes a natural scheme-theoretic and arithmetic geometric boundary of a standard resolution operation for an infinite intrinsic family of A-type rational double points; normalized charts alone do not recover the conductor.
